meta.name: Luz The Light of the Heart
meta.description: Raised by a kind Kaingang family, adventurous young schoolgirl Luz launches a quest with her firefly companion to learn the truth about her roots.

videos.title: The Girl and the Firefly
videos.overview: Luz is welcomed into and raised as an equal in the Kaingang community. But a secret between Gá and Baltazar could change it all.

videos.title: A Light at the End of the Tunnel
videos.overview: Joca shows Luz around the school. However, keeping her a secret becomes challenging when Sabina won't stop asking questions.

videos.title: Fire! Fire!
videos.overview: Marcos meets Luz and tries to earn her trust. Joca's fire story grabs unexpected — and unwanted — attention, especially from Principal Isabela.

videos.title: A Flame That Never Goes Out
videos.overview: After meeting Gá, Marcos finds out all about Luz's past. Sabina pushes Joca to tell the truth about his friend, leading to a big revelation.

videos.title: The Teacher's Indigenous Cousin
videos.overview: Baltazar follows a lead in his investigation. Otávio accidentally tells Principal Isabela about Luz.

videos.title: A Singular Student
videos.overview: When inspectors visit Prex, Principal Isabela faces a tough decision about Luz. Marcos and Joca have a plan to help her make the right choice.

videos.title: Light the Way
videos.overview: Nic gets in the way of Sabina's evil plan. Marcos and Dora buy new clothes for Luz, who feels pressured to take official photos for the school website.

videos.title: Number One
videos.overview: Luz makes a bold move to avoid posing for Prex's website photos. Baltazar questions Isabela. Carlos tries to intimidate Gá's family.

videos.title: A Dark Night
videos.overview: Luz searches for a photo of her grandfather. Marcos goes on a date with Fernanda. Over the weekend, the kids gather to share stories around the fire.

videos.title: Found Among the Fireflies
videos.overview: Dora reminisces about her past. Chaos breaks loose during the school's play. Marcos and Dora search for Luz.

videos.title: The Light That Never Goes Out
videos.overview: Dora persuades Luz to return to school. Carlos instructs Valéria to deal with Baltazar. Principal Isabela makes a decision regarding the fourth grade.

videos.title: The Storyteller
videos.overview: New students join the fourth grade, but not everyone's happy about it. Valéria snoops around Dora's bookshop, and Otávio has a big talk with his mother.

videos.title: You Are Never Alone
videos.overview: Carlos pays a visit to the bookshop. Gael asks Dora an important question. Meanwhile, Cadu and Sabina compete to become fourth-grade class president.

videos.title: They've Seen the Light
videos.overview: Dora's storytelling activity leads to a family reunion. Baltazar confronts Valéria. Marcos tells Luz a secret about her family that changes everything.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: After hearing shocking news, Luz starts to feel unwell. Gael's ambitious plans don't go as expected. Otávio and Sabina take the stage in art class.

videos.title: Clues
videos.overview: Marcos looks into Luz's father's past. Carlos shares his plans to buy the bookshop, and Dora remembers a special gift from a past love.

videos.title: The Firefly Necklace
videos.overview: Lia grows anxious about the art competition while Nic plots a revolution. Luz attempts to visit Dora at the bookshop, but someone gets in her way.

videos.title: Monster Grandpa
videos.overview: Luz makes a special request to Lia, and Sabina steps up to help a friend. Meanwhile, Gael resorts to desperate measures to clear his debts.

videos.title: Parents and Children
videos.overview: Dora tells Marcos she needs some time near her family. The kids don't like having their performance displayed at school — it's time to take action.

videos.title: The Firefly and the Stars
videos.overview: Marcos reveals the truth about Luz's past to Dora. Principal Isabela springs into action after a meeting, and friends and families reunite at last.
